claims.text: Pneumococcal: PCV15, PCV20 or PCV21 if ⍉prior conjugate (PCV15 → PPSV23 ≥8 wks later).
claims.quote: should be given PCV15, PCV20, or PCV21; if PCV15 is given, follow with PPSV23 ≥ 8 weeks after the PCV15 dose
All patients should be given the influenza vaccine annually
All patients should be given the hepatitis B vaccine

claims.text: HAV vaccine if @ risk or desired.
claims.quote: Patients at risk of hepatitis A or desiring protection from it should be given the hepatitis A vaccine
At the appropriate age, males and females should be given the human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine

claims.text: MenACWY: 2-dose series ≥8 wks apart, revaccinate q5 yrs.
claims.quote: should be given a 2-dose primary series of MenACWY ≥ 8 weeks apart and be revaccinated every 5 years
All patients should be given the recombinant zoster vaccine

claims.text: Varicella and MMR: ⍉if CD4 % <15 or CD4 <200.
claims.quote: these vaccines are contraindicated in patients with CD4 percentage < 15% or CD4 count < 200 cells/mcL
Patients with HIV infection should receive the full series of a COVID-19 vaccine and recommended booster doses
Mpox vaccination is recommended for people with HIV infection who are at risk of mpox
